The 2023 scheme judgment treated one contested trust or secured-claim theory as, at best, an unsecured personal claim, but that reasoning should not be generalized to all customers without product-specific documents.
affected_product: Babel institutional lending, managed assets and prime-finance claims
notes: Unknown is retained deliberately. Product terms, contracting entity and claim basis may affect treatment under the scheme.
